newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens wins 150 mln DM Turkey power order.
newsitem.headline: Siemens wins 150 mln DM Turkey power order.

text.p: German industrial giant Siemens AG said on Friday its KWU power generation unit won a 150 million mark order for power generation equipment in Turkey.

KWU would supply two gas turbines, a steam turbine, three generators, control equipment and construction management services for a 480 megawatt power plant in Marmara Ereglisi, a town about 100 kilometers west of Istanbul.
Siemens would use its facilities in Berlin, in Muelheim in the Ruhr area and in the east German city of Erfurt to manufacture the turbines.
The Marmara plant should go on stream by the spring of 1999, Siemens said.
